title: VerifierQ: Enhancing LLM Test Time Compute with Q-Learning-based Verifiers
authors_zh: Jianing Qi（CUNY 研究生中心）；Hao Tang（CUNY 研究生中心、曼哈顿社区学院）；Zhigang Zhu（CUNY 研究生中心、纽约市立学院）
paper_type_zh: 面向测试时扩展的离线 Q-learning 验证器研究
best_for_zh: 研究过程验证器、数学推理候选选择与验证器标度的读者。
one_line: VerifierQ trains an utterance-level Q-value verifier offline, aiming to select stronger multistep mathematical solutions under a test-time compute budget.
VerifierQ 用离线 Q-learning 训练步骤级验证器，在增加推理候选时更有效地评估和选择数学解答。
why: It exposes verifier training, not just generator sampling, as a scaling lever and tests it against PRM and majority voting.
inclusion_reason: It studies verifier strength as the component that makes additional test-time reasoning candidates selectable, with explicit scaling comparisons.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time compute improves mathematical reasoning only when a system can distinguish promising solution paths from plausible-looking errors. Process reward models provide step scores, but conventional supervised training does not directly optimize the long-horizon value of a partial utterance, and online Q-learning is difficult because utterance-level actions create an enormous action space.

VerifierQ asks whether a verifier can be trained from fixed reasoning data as an offline critic. The paper targets a process-level record containing a question, partial solution, utterance action, and correctness reward, and seeks a value estimate that lets a generator-verifier system make better use of multiple sampled solutions without requiring new online search during verifier training.

测试时计算只有在系统能把有希望的解答路径与貌似合理的错误区分开时，才能改善数学推理。过程奖励模型提供步骤分数，但常规监督训练并不直接优化一个部分语句的长程价值；在线 Q-learning 又很困难，因为语句级动作会产生极大的动作空间。

VerifierQ 研究能否从固定推理数据中把验证器训练成离线批评者。论文的目标过程记录包含问题、部分解答、语句动作和正确性奖励，并寻求一种价值估计，使生成器—验证器系统能更好利用多个采样解答，而无需在训练验证器时进行新的在线搜索。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
VerifierQ treats a multistep solution as an utterance-level Markov decision process. A partial solution is the state, the next utterance is the action, and the verifier predicts a bounded Q-value expressing the downstream promise of that action. Rather than sample many possible next utterances to compute a maximum, it uses an implicit Q-learning value approximation that is compatible with offline data.

The method also adds a two-expectile conservative Q-learning term to control overestimation. The resulting verifier is not merely a classifier of the current step; it is trained to propagate future reward information through the solution. At test time, this Q-value signal is used to evaluate candidate solutions, changing the quality of selection as the number of generated solutions grows.

VerifierQ 将多步解答视为语句级马尔可夫决策过程。部分解答是状态，下一句是动作，验证器预测有界 Q 值来表达该动作的下游前景。它不为计算最大值而采样许多可能的下一句，而使用与离线数据兼容的隐式 Q-learning 价值近似。

方法还加入双 expectile 的保守 Q-learning 项以控制高估。所得验证器不只是当前步骤的分类器；它被训练为在解答中传播未来奖励信息。测试时，该 Q 值信号用来评估候选解答，从而改变生成解答数量增加时的选择质量。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper represents a state as the problem plus all generated utterances so far, and marks a correct step with reward one and an incorrect step with reward zero. Its modified Bellman target keeps Q-values in the unit interval. A separate value function approximates the large-action-space maximum, while a conservative term and Polyak-averaged target network are intended to reduce offline overestimation and stabilize updates.

Experiments use TinyLlama-1.1B, initialized through MetaMath and process-reward training. The authors evaluate GSM8K and a 500-question MATH subset, comparing VerifierQ with majority voting, PRM, standard Q-learning, and IQL variants. The card records the linked source datasets, but the paper promises implementation release only in the future, so exact training code is not currently an official artifact.

论文把状态表示为问题加上此前所有生成语句，并把正确步骤记为奖励一、错误步骤记为奖励零。其修改的 Bellman 目标使 Q 值保持在单位区间。独立价值函数近似大动作空间中的最大值；保守项和 Polyak 平均目标网络旨在减少离线高估并稳定更新。

实验使用 TinyLlama-1.1B，经 MetaMath 与过程奖励训练初始化。作者在 GSM8K 和 500 问题的 MATH 子集上评估，将 VerifierQ 与多数投票、PRM、标准 Q-learning 和 IQL 变体比较。卡片记录了链接的数据来源，但论文只承诺未来发布实现，因此精确训练代码目前不是官方工件。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that VerifierQ outperforms one- and two-epoch PRM training and majority voting on the reported GSM8K and MATH solution-count curves. The comparison is relevant because the generator and test-time candidate pool are held within the same mathematical-reasoning setting, so the measured difference is attributed to the selector rather than only to additional sampling.

The evidence is qualified by model scale. On MATH, the authors note that all methods can underperform majority vote with the 1.1B model, and the best expectile differs by dataset. They also report roughly tenfold training-time savings over step-by-step Q estimation in preliminary experiments. These results support feasibility, but not an established advantage for large reasoning models or all verifier data distributions.

论文报告，在所述 GSM8K 和 MATH 解答数量曲线上，VerifierQ 优于训练一轮或两轮的 PRM 以及多数投票。该比较相关，因为生成器和测试时候选池都处于相同数学推理设置中，测得差异可归因于选择器，而不仅是额外采样。

证据受到模型规模限制。在 MATH 上，作者指出使用 1.1B 模型时所有方法都可能弱于多数投票，且最佳 expectile 随数据集而变。他们还在初步实验中报告，相比逐步骤 Q 值估计，训练时间约节省十倍。这支持可行性，但未证明它对大推理模型或所有验证器数据分布都有既定优势。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier verifier work commonly trains a process reward model by supervised step labels, while Q-learning approaches often rely on online action sampling. VerifierQ changes the verifier-training objective: it uses an utterance-level offline Q-learning formulation with a bounded Bellman update, IQL-based maximum approximation, and adjustable conservative Q-learning. This makes the verifier's score an estimate of continuation value rather than only local label likelihood.

The paper does not introduce a new mathematical dataset or a new generator. Its distinct contribution is a critic-side scaling mechanism that can be compared directly with PRM and voting as candidate count rises. The important audit question is whether its process labels, offline trajectories, and hyperparameters support the assumed MDP and whether the Q-value remains calibrated enough to rank novel paths.

既有验证器工作常用监督步骤标签训练过程奖励模型，而 Q-learning 方法又常依赖在线动作采样。VerifierQ 改变了验证器训练目标：它使用语句级离线 Q-learning 表述，配以有界 Bellman 更新、基于 IQL 的最大值近似和可调保守 Q-learning。这使验证器分数成为延续价值的估计，而不只是局部标签概率。

论文没有引入新数学数据集或新生成器。其独特贡献是批评者一侧的扩展机制，可在候选数量上升时直接与 PRM 和投票比较。重要审计问题是过程标签、离线轨迹和超参数是否支持假设的 MDP，以及 Q 值能否保持足够校准以排序新路径。

title: Limitations
局限
html: VerifierQ is evaluated with TinyLlama-1.1B and is sensitive to the expectile choice; the paper itself notes dataset-dependent settings and memory/compute cost above a PRM. Offline Q-learning can still overestimate unfamiliar paths when process labels or rollout support are weak. The code is not publicly released in the checked version, and the data lineage spans several external datasets, so reproduction and license review require more work than a self-contained benchmark package.
VerifierQ 使用 TinyLlama-1.1B 评估，并对 expectile 选择敏感；论文自身指出不同数据集需要不同设置，且其显存和计算成本高于 PRM。当过程标签或轨迹支持较弱时，离线 Q-learning 仍可能高估陌生路径。核验版本尚未公开代码，且数据谱系跨越多个外部数据集，因此复现和许可证审查比自包含基准包需要更多工作。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a reasoning system already has multistep solution traces and needs a verifier that values future solvability rather than only local step plausibility. A replication should log the state/action boundary, reward definition, value range, expectile settings, candidate count, and final selection rule; it should also compare against a supervised PRM at equal generator and sampling budgets. The paper is a useful design reference for verifier scaling, but its current missing code makes it unsuitable as a drop-in implementation recipe.
当推理系统已有多步骤解答轨迹，并需要一个衡量未来可解性而非只衡量局部步骤合理性的验证器时，可使用本文。复现应记录状态与动作边界、奖励定义、价值范围、expectile 设置、候选数量和最终选择规则，并在相同生成器与采样预算下和监督 PRM 比较。论文是验证器扩展的有用设计参考，但当前缺少代码，不适合作为可直接替换的实现配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper's scale lever is the verifier, not the language model being sampled. Its action granularity is an utterance rather than a token, which motivates IQL approximation and the conservative term. Keep the evaluation boundary visible: TinyLlama, GSM8K, and a 500-question MATH subset. The strongest claim is that offline critic learning can improve test-time selection under those conditions; it is not yet evidence of broad large-model scaling or released-code reproducibility.
论文的扩展杠杆是验证器，而非被采样的语言模型。其动作粒度是语句而非令牌，这解释了为何需要 IQL 近似和保守项。应保持评测边界可见：TinyLlama、GSM8K 和 500 问题 MATH 子集。最强主张是在这些条件下离线批评者学习可改善测试时选择；它尚不是大模型广泛扩展或已发布代码可复现性的证据。
